subject: Log your lifts, share your runs, see your recovery
message:
Hey {name},

Thanks for training with Mileset and for backing it this early. It means a lot, and there's more on the way soon.

New in the app this week:

My workouts: under More, build your own session (a shoulder day, say), log weight and reps, and watch each lift climb week to week.

Share your run: open a workout and tap Share image. Pick a see-through sticker with your stats, route or splits for your Instagram Story.

Recovery in one place: today's readiness and the numbers behind it, plus one chart for sleep and, with a watch, HRV and resting heart rate over 14 or 30 days.

You're a founding member, so Mileset stays free for you for life. Know someone who runs or lifts? Share Mileset with them before the Founding 100 fills up.

Follow along on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hybrdrunning/

What would make Mileset better for you? Reply with any idea. I read them all.

Matthew
Mileset
